criteria.false: The function is memory-safe: all buffer accesses are in bounds, memory is freed exactly once and not used afterwards, pointers are checked or valid before dereference, allocations are released and variables are initialised before use.

criteria.false: The function is memory-safe: all buffer accesses are in bounds, memory is freed exactly once and not used afterwards, pointers are checked or valid before dereference, allocations are released and variables are initialised before use.

criteria.false: The function is memory-safe: all buffer accesses are in bounds, memory is freed exactly once and not used afterwards, pointers are checked or valid before dereference, allocations are released and variables are initialised before use.

criteria.false: The function is memory-safe: all buffer accesses are in bounds, memory is freed exactly once and not used afterwards, pointers are checked or valid before dereference, allocations are released and variables are initialised before use.
